messages:
will: Quick follow-up from today's sync: need a compact contract for hosted/dedicated/private about who can change routing/flags. Proposal: probe-first + signed policy snapshots + manifest policy_influence enum.

rhea: Agree on probe-first. Client should emit capability manifest at bootstrap, shim verifies local capabilities and returns effective policy.

omar: For private installs, manifest wins unless manifest.policy_influence == "authoritative". Default for private should be "advisory" so ops control upgrades.

luis: Signed snapshot format suggestion: JSONL or small protobuf with header {snapshot_id, issuer, issued_at, ttl} and policies[] entries: {route, action, fallback, max_seq_len, qos_hint}. Include signature metadata.

will: Telemetry note: shim emits decision events (snapshot_id, manifest_hash, decision, tokens, latency_ms). No prompt text. Buffer to disk if no egress.

rhea: Circuit breaker behavior: client-local CB must trigger on configured error budget or latency p95; fallback immediately without control-plane roundtrip. Control plane may recommend thresholds but client must enforce offline.

omar: Emergency-off: control plane can publish revocations for snapshot_ids; shim must check on reconnect. Also a local admin toggle to ignore snapshots until reconciled.

luis: Implementation: persist snapshots in shim directory (sqlite or small file), keep N snapshots, verify signature on import. Provide redwoodctl to sign snapshots for on-prem CI.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary 8% -> enable_flag "lite_quant" for hosted-us-east (ts 4832110015)

will: UX question: should hosted treat advisory snapshots as authoritative during explicit canary windows? I think yes if manifest.opt_in_canary == true.

rhea: fine but make it explicit and timeboxed (canary_ttl). Document rollback path and emergency-off steps.

omar: I'll draft the small manifest additions: policy_influence enum, control_authoritative boolean, canary_opt_in + canary_ttl + policy_ttl.

luis: I'll draft snapshot proto + example CLI steps for signing/import.

will: Good owners. I'll file RFC referencing these artifacts and include the precedence rule: manifest pins > snapshot (if authoritative) > snapshot (advisory) > local heuristics. Marking this as next-RFC work item. :white_check_mark:
